record.label: Negative-moment Gaussian raw-moment fallback
record.summary: The fixed source-independent probe replaced a full marginal tuple by its Gaussian positive-part tuple whenever propagated third or fourth raw moment was negative. It activated 1,609 times and recovered two registered parent failures, but the preregistered fatal gates still failed: three parent-finite fixtures became nonfinite, one represented fourth moment remained negative, and official-He width 32 seed 20260825 changed catastrophically with final disagreement MSE 1.7171762496955415e15. This rejects only the exact negative-moment trigger and Gaussian fallback; coherent connected-state shutdown or another joint high-order repair remains open.
